description: MEXICO. Computes the property acquisition tax (ISAI, ISABI, ISTD… set by each municipality or state) and the state's fee to record the deed on a home purchase, from the 2026 laws read, in 54 municipalities (Cancún, Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Puerto Vallarta, Bahía de Banderas, Los Cabos, La Paz, Mazatlán, San Miguel de Allende, Mérida, Guadalajara, Querétaro, Tijuana…). Base = the higher of the price and the appraisal or cadastral value. Others return "not computed" with no figure. Notary fees are not computed.

appraisal_or_cadastral_value.description: Appraisal or cadastral value in MXN, if higher than the price.

municipality.description: Municipality or locality, e.g. "Cancún", "Nuevo Vallarta", "Cabo San Lucas", "San Miguel de Allende".

name: closing_costs_mx
title: Mexican property acquisition tax and recording fee, by municipality
